sentences.en: He was fortunate to find the book he had lost.
sentences.zh: 他很幸运找到了丢失的书。

sentences.en: He was so fortunate as it find a good job.
sentences.zh: 他非常幸运能找到一份好工作。

sentences.en: It's very fortunate that this is not a traffic jam.
sentences.zh: 很幸运这不是交通堵塞。

senses.zh: 侥幸的，幸运的,带来幸运的，吉利的n.有好运的人
